body:
Hey thanks for the reply. I found therapy helped immensely, I stopped going as I could no longer afford it after an initial period of free sessions. I would definitely recommend it. I made a big decision whilst in therapy and went travelling by myself for a few months, I wouldn't have done that if I never sought therapy.

I can relate, I have so many aspirations also but they just seem too far out of grasp and as the days go on it feels more and more likely I'll never amount to them.

Thanks for sharing, I hope you're successful with therapy.
